the synthesis and structural characterization of two new cationic pyridinium borates, [3]OTF and [4] OTF, and their fluoride ion adducts, 3-F and [4]F, is reported.
the synthesis and characterization of two pyridinium boron compounds, [3]OTF and [4] OTf, which extract fluoride ions biphenically from aqueous solution, is reported.

the development of novel boron-containing compounds as selective anion sensors and their application in the extraction of anions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the first colorimetric turn-on fluoride ion sensors based on cationic boranes in H2O-CHCl3 mix.
we have developed a simple colorimetric method for the detection of fluoride ions in organic solvents and in H2O.
pyridinium borane derivatives are promising anion receptors in biphasic systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of boron and pyridinium moieties in the same cationic receptor is an effective way to obtain anion receptors with a strong affinity for F(-) in H2O, which is accompanied by a color change that can be easily monitored by eye.
the pyridinium borane motif is an excellent platform for the development of new colorimetric sensors for fluoride ions in biphasic H2O/organic solvent mixtures.
the combination of a triorgano-fluoroborate moietyl with an aromatic donor group can be used for the development of colorimetric fluoride ion sensors.
